title: Digital Nitrogen Tyre Inflator for Two Wheeler - NITROJET 2000 LCV P
description: Digital nitrogen tyre inflator specifically designed for two wheelers with pleasant LED display.
subtitle: For Two Wheeler
fullDescription: Digital nitrogen tyre inflator for two wheelers. Features intelligent single digital readouts both for set pressure and tyre pressure, pleasant LED display for attractive night visibility, pressure switch for automatic nitrogen generation cut-off, and pressure gauge for nitrogen pressure indication.
features: Intelligent single digital readouts both for set pressure and tyre pressure
Pleasant LED display for attractive night visibility
Display remain at same set pressure value even after power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
LED indication for the status of operation
Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or puncture tyre
25/35 key for easy front and back tyre pressure setting
Pressure switch for automatic nitrogen generation cut-off
Pressure gauge for nitrogen pressure indication
Can use for vehicle tyre range within two wheelers

specifications.display: Single LED display both for tyre pressure, set pressure
specifications.outputHose: 10 mtrs 8 x5 mm Coiled PU hose with clip on Air chuck
specifications.functionalKeys: Membrane keypad suitable for outdoor application
specifications.overPressureSafety: Pressure switch with automatic on - off setting
specifications.dimensions: 495 x 325 x 1215 mm (pedestal), 590 x 360 x 1275 mm (with Packing)
